AI agents need more than one perfectly written prompt. Martin Keen explains loop engineering and how AI agents act, observe, adjust, and repeat toward measurable goals. Learn how context, tools, subagents, and human oversight make agentic loops work.

 00:00 – Understand Loop Engineering vs Prompt Engineering
 01:18 – Build an AI Agent Loop Around a Goal
 02:30 – Define Goals AI Agents Can Actually Verify
 03:29 – Engineer Triggers, Schedules & Hooks
 04:18 – Manage Agent Context, Skills & Persistent State
 05:37 – Give AI Agents Tools with MCP & APIs
 06:10 – Use Subagents to Check AI Agent Work
 07:11 – Keep Humans Inside Agentic Loops
 07:49 – Avoid Comprehension & Intent Debt
 10:05 – Define the Human Role in Loop Engineering
